categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Categories label what each transaction was for. Give each one a match pattern and new transactions are filed automatically, or assign them by hand. Aim to get every transaction categorized, because budgets, reports and expected income all depend on it. Mark the categories your pay is deposited into as payroll.

kind.label: Counts as
kind.saveFailed: Could not save the category type.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Budgets set a monthly amount for one or more categories. Expected income (typical monthly pay over the last 6 months) is shown next to the total you've budgeted. Aim to budget less than you expect to earn, and the difference is your planned savings. A fixed budget is a spending limit that resets each month. An accruing budget sets the amount aside every month and carries unspent money forward, which suits irregular costs like car repairs or annual fees.
budgets.monthOnlyNotice: Budgets are tracked month by month, so this page is showing {month} regardless of the year / all-time filter.

plan.title: Monthly plan
plan.expectedIncomeBasis: Typical pay (median) of each payroll category over the last {months, plural, one {month} other {# months}}
plan.noPayroll: No payroll found in the previous months, so expected income is zero. Mark the categories your pay is deposited into as payroll (here, or under Settings → Categories or Groups) to estimate your income.
plan.payrollCandidates: Which of these is your pay? Only categories you mark as payroll count towards expected income.

plan.accruingBudgetsCaption: Set aside every month. Balance across all accruing budgets: {balance}

plan.unaccountedTitle: Spending not accounted for by a budget
plan.unaccountedHelp: Categorize these transactions, or add their categories to a budget, so every dollar is accounted for.

budgets.pace: Where an even spend would be by today

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups bundle related categories, such as "Utilities" or "Transport", so you can see and budget them together. Aim for every category to belong to a group. Marking a group as payroll treats all of its categories as income.

kind.label: Counts as
kind.help: Every category in a payroll group counts as payroll (income).
